items.body: Review by DiversionConVinilos — This new album by muktrinstumentalist Juan Belda & The Bit Band is a really solid avant-garde album that stays completely away from commercial formulas. For me, the best part of the record is how naturally it mixes contemporary jazz, prog rock, and electronic elements. Even though the compositions are quite complex and experimental, the music flows easily and keeps a very engaging, steady groove throughout the whole listening experience. The collaborations with great musicians like Jorge Pardo and Markus Breuss also add a really nice touch to the tracks. Overall, it feels like a very honest, thoughtful, and independent project that focuses on creative freedom without any restrictions.

items._cn_summary: 这是一张融合当代爵士、前卫摇滚与电子元素的器乐专辑，强调创意自由与独立精神。Juan Belda 与多位乐手合作，作品在复杂编曲与即兴段落之间保持流畅的律动感，避免落入商业套路。评论特别指出专辑的核心价值在于不同流派之间的自然衔接——合成器音色与爵士即兴并置，结构虽实验却不晦涩。Jorge Pardo 与 Markus Breuss 等客座乐手的加入丰富了整体的声音层次，使听感始终保持新鲜。这张专辑适合关注跨界融合、追求独立制作审美的听众。

items.body: J’adore tes mains qui me serrent, Vraiment, très fort. J’adore tes mains qui me serrent, Toujours, pas mort. To be a true goth is to know that death is always in the room, so you might as well make the room worth entering. It means treating sorrow with ceremony, desire with drama, and decay with enough affection that the grave begins to look less like an ending and more like a place to meet. The clothes, the eyeliner, the cemetery romance, and the tragic poses are all part of the pleasure, but they are props, not proof. Once goth becomes a purity test, it usually shrinks, like a black T-shirt left too long in the dryer. That tension between devotion and absurdity sits at the center of Une Vraie Gothique’s Nuée Ardente, which treats being goth as a private joke whispered in a chapel where stained glass and club lighting are usually one and the same. As Une Vraie Gothique, Ulrika and Ferdinand Legendre move between German and French, entering the frame like two people trying on the airs of doom and gloom, discovering that it suits them, and laughing at how well it fits. Nuée Ardente comes from the duo’s album R.D.V au cimetière, a record that turns the cemetery rendezvous of its title into a meeting place for desire, theatre, and darkroom absurdity. The song makes a natural entry point into the album because it understands the glamour of overstatement. Its EBM and dark electro references are clear enough to be clocked by anyone with boots, eyeliner, and a shelf of old club flyers, yet the video treats those markers as moving parts rather than scene credentials. Hands grip, mouths open, and a blood moon hovers in the lyrics like cheap theatre suddenly made serious. Bodies press against darkness until darkness becomes theatre itself, flirting with the ridiculous in order to reach a truer heat. Anaïs Novembre directs the video for Nuée Ardente with a taste for pressure: close bodies, sharp cuts, faces caught between devotion and daftness, and a dance floor turned into a furnace for young self-invention. Her touch feels like Gaspar Noé, Clouzot, and Häxan run through a photocopier left too close to the strobes. The editing carries a woozy charge, but its frenzy feels affectionate, almost protective of the duo’s wish to become “true goth.” That phrase, with all its adolescent grandeur, is the key. In a scene so fond of costume, the search for authenticity can look absurd, and Une Vraie Gothique understands how fertile that absurdity can be. Their video leans into sex, witchiness, theatrical pain, and cemetery chic with a raised eyebrow that never cancels the thrill. Watch the video for Nuée Ardente below: Listen to Nuée Ardente below and order R.D.V au cimetière here. items._cn_summary: 法国双人组合Une Vraie Gothique在专辑《R.D.V au cimetière》中以戈特文化为创作核心，将EBM与暗潮电动的冷峻节拍与法语歌词结合，探讨死亡、欲望与戏剧化情感之间微妙张力。歌曲《Nuée Ardente》作为专辑切入点，将俱乐部灯光与教堂彩窗并置，戏谑式拥抱哥特亚文化的浮夸美学。MV由Anaïs Novembre执导，以高压式亲密镜头与血色月光构建仪式感，剪辑风格受Gaspar Noé与Häxan影响，将荒诞与真情熔于一炉。整体刻意模糊真诚与做作的边界，使墓地成为欲望、剧场与暗黑幽默的交汇空间，为传统哥特主题注入自觉的剧场性与自我意识。

items.body: It's funny how music echoes in more ways than one. Beyond the physical, aural phenomena, there is something of the echo in how music influences itself, how artists, genres, and styles emerge from each other. It might just be an artifact of being an avid, long time listener but even if so, who cares? It's all in the ear of the listener, is it not? In any case, I find myself understanding influences, progressions, and lineages after the fact, like an echo emerging from a sound that it itself created. Here's an example: Junius. The influence of Junius on post-metal cannot be overstated. Both The Martyrdom of a Catastrophist (2009) and Reports from the Threshold of Death (2011) were progenitors of the genre and high water marks for its quality. What drew people (or, at least, me) to these albums was a lot of things to be sure but much of it were the unique, darkwave (think Depeche Mode) inflected vocals of Joseph E. Martinez.Then, supposedly separately, I started noticing a shift in post-rock and metal over the last few years. I've written about it on the blog - gone were the scintillatingly hazy vocals that sometimes appeared on post-rock (which was, and still is, mostly instrumental) and present now were somber, dark, melancholic vocals. Oh Hiroshima and Towers of Jupiter are probably my go to examples but there are more. I was sort of surprised by this shift and didn't have a lot of influences to put it into context. Until Junius came back and released Sotera and I was suddenly reminded of where I knew this all from. You can't really blame me, right? The band's last release was in 2017. But suddenly, I remembered that it was Junius, at the very start of the "third" wave of post-rock, which introduced that kind of murky, alternative, melancholic sound to the genre via the vocals. And once I remembered it, I could not stop listening to Sotera. Both the bands I cited above and the others who have been making music in this style are great but Junius are Junius and Sotera is one of the best albums I've heard in this style, including when compared to their previous release. I absolutely adore how deep Martinez goes here, both with his vocals and with the rest of the instrumentation.Check out "Scythian" for example, probably my favorite track from that album. The main riff is so bottomless, so potent with energy. Especially when backed up by those deep, deep kick drums, cold as hell synth lines and, above it all, Martinez's voice resplendent in a harsh light. And those are the clean vocals! The harsh screams work beautifully as well, married to the noisier, more explosive parts of the track. All of this conjures a goth grandeur, a theatrical conjuring of affect and emotion. "Scythian" closes off the album with these majestically dark sounds but the rest of the work has plenty of them as well. But it's a standout in the execution of the style and a phenomenal reminder that Junius are not only masters of it but one of the original voices within it. Sotera is a magisterial comeback album and a very interesting past/present/future step in the resurgence of a darker, more gothic style of post rock and metal. Sotera by Junius
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑是Junius时隔多年回归之作，评论者认为它延续并强化了乐队标志性的暗潮风格，将Depeche Mode式阴郁人声注入后金属与后摇框架。主唱Joseph E. Martinez的演唱深沉而富有戏剧张力，清声与嘶吼交替，与冰冷的合成器线条、沉重的底鼓及厚重的吉他riff交织，营造出歌特式的宏大氛围。评论以曲目《Scythian》为例，指出其riff深邃有力，节奏压迫感十足，人声在高光下绽放，整体呈现出剧场化的情感召唤。评论者还提出一个更大的观察：Junius早在2009和2011年的两张专辑中就为后摇/后金属第三波引入了这种暗潮化的忧郁人声，而近年Oh Hiroshima、Towers of Jupiter等乐队正是这一脉络的继承者，Sotera则再次确认了Junius作为这一风格源头的地位。

items.excerpt: Finally, Kompakt issue a true GAS outlier on vinyl for the first time, recorded in 1989 and containing some of Wolfgang Voigt’s earliest and starkest recycling of magisterial...
items._cn_summary: Kompakt 厂牌首次将 Wolfgang Voigt 1989 年的早期作品以黑胶形式发行，这是 GAS 项目的真正异数。Voigt 早期的循环采样手法在此已显现雏形，将庄严的古典素材解构为极简、冥想式的电子片段。这些录音距离他后来成熟 GAS 作品的氛围密度尚有距离，但已展现出他对素材反复打磨与剥离的执着。黑胶版本本身就具有档案意义，让听众得以追溯这位德国电子音乐人艺术轨迹的起点。整体而言，这张发行介于历史文献与独立聆听价值之间，适合研究 Voigt 创作演变或探索早期德国极简电子场景的听众。

items.body: For an overview of the what, the why, and the where of this music, do read my review of Volume 1 of this series. Essentially, this collection is more of what made Volume 1 so infectious. Yet, what makes this music so fascinating in general, that is, beyond its unswerving ability to fill dance floors, is the fact that these two islands, part of the Paises Africanos de Lingua Oficial Portuguesa (PALOP) regions of the world, are the second smallest African country; Seychelles is smaller. There are only 12 villages on Sao Tom�, lots of rain forest and, not surprisingly, lots of rain. I mention this because one could be fooled into thinking, with music like what�s on offer here, there must have been a music scene larger than there actually was. Not that little was happening, but that less got recorded or released than it might have had there been a city such as Lagos or Nairobi with the studios, labels, and pressing plants to better document it all. The music here, like Volume 1- recorded during Africa�s so-called golden age- is known as Puxa, a complex stew of ingredients from other former African Portuguese colonies mixed with rhythms that, with the help of dancers, can summon spirits or exorcise demons. At least according to some. It�s worth knowing that a 100 years or so ago, the Portuguese banned Puxa dance; it�s also worth knowing they appear to have failed miserably at this silly endeavor. Tucked away in modern Puxa is merengue, Kompas, Soukouss, Benga, and much else. One suspects much of this is coincidental, while other grooves were definitely imported considering both Portuguese rule and the islands� location over the Atlantic from the Caribbean. But don�t be fooled into thinking these two islands don�t have their own thing, as the sounds on this collection show. L�VE L�VE Vol. 2: Sao Tom� & Principe Sounds 70s-80s - Pedro Lima Pedro Lima, who has featured in his own Bongo Joe collection, leads a fiery band, complete with choked guitar vamps tussling with a kit drummer as a lead guitar comments from the sidelines on �Sossegado.� Elsewhere, Sangazuza demonstrates what happens when the bass and keys drop out, leaving the drummers and guitars to ride out a groove and drive dancers mad in the process. Check �Sono s� ku� de t�ma� or �Mairo bi cedo� for their ability to place a firm finger on the pulse. Over 15 tracks, the collection shows off multiple guitars weaving and circling one another, with lead and harmony vocals constantly in response, becoming part of the songs� melodic framework. At any given moment, vocals give way as the music unspools and floats on grooves that must have gone on for hours live. Africa Negra�s �Apoi�mos a luta dos nossos irm�os� is one example. L�VE L�VE Vol. 2: Sao Tom� & Principe Sounds 70s-80s by Various Artists In general, what�s on offer here, like Volume 1, was recorded at Radio Sao Tom� e Principe (RSTP), often taped in the courtyard outside at night, and released on cassette or occasionally, vinyl. It captures the joy of post-1975 independence and only fizzled out as styles changed and musicians struggled to make ends meet. Yet, take a quick listen to recent RSTP programming, which features musicians such as Babilonia or Calema, and you�ll still hear Puxa rhythms, showing just how potent the music form this two-island nation is on a global level. And Bongo Joe, who have also released two volumes featuring the above mentioned Africa Negra, have given this music the treatment it deserves, with extensive notes on the country�s history, vintage photographs, and band discographies. Various Artists - L�ve L�ve (Volume1) (Review) Pedro Lima - Maguidala (Review) Ann O'aro - Bleu (Review)

items._cn_summary: 这张合辑聚焦圣多美和普林西比这一西非小岛国于七十至八十年代录制的Puxa舞厅音乐，深入挖掘了该国有限录音条件下被忽视的声响遗产。乐评人结合第一卷的背景概述，强调其与大西洋对岸加勒比海地区的歷史渊源，指出Puxa融汇了美瑞姆巴、孔帕斯、索库斯、本加等多种节奏元素，充满召唤与驱邪的仪式感。专辑由Pedro Lima领衔的多支乐队参与录制，十五首曲目展现了多把吉他交织缠绕、主唱与和声彼此呼应的现场律动。评论特别提及若干曲目在贝斯与键盘退场后，鼓与吉他如何延续groove并点燃舞池。整张唱片由独立小厂Bongo Joe发行，呈现了一个被低估的非洲角落如何在葡萄牙殖民与海洋地理的双重作用下，发展出独具一格的岛屿舞乐。

items.body: Those of us who have been digging into Analog Africa�s increasingly formidable releases over the last two decades are well aware of the massive amount of raw, vodun-based Sato and Sakpata-derived funk the label has issued by Benin�s most prolific 1970s-era band, the Orchestre Poly-Ritmo. AA has dropped no fewer than 3 compilations of their heaviest material, as well as a reissue of the band�s first LP, in an effort to give them the international status they deserve. That being said, what might be different about this collection of their music? And who is Antoine Dougb�? Antoine Dougb� et L'Orchestre Poly-Rythmo De Cotonou 1977 - 1982 (Analog Africa No.44) by Analog Africa As it turns out, Dougb� was a song-conjurer whose mode of musical transfer was slapping his legs in a rhythm known as Cavacha, a groove created by drummer Belobi Meridjo, who was inspired by a train cadence that he worked into a pattern that ultimately spread like a 21st century California wildfire throughout Congolese pop music in the mid-1970s. Dougb�, known as the �Devil�s Prime Minister,� was also a practitioner of vodun who inspired fear in any musician he felt was unsuited to play his music, which is how he landed on working exclusively Poly-Ritmo, as he felt they could nail what he wanted in ways other bands couldn�t. His recording career was brief - 3 albums and a few singles - but as this collection shows, it was potent. Antoine Dougb� et L'Orchestre Poly-Rythmo De Cotonou 1977 - 1982 (Analog Africa No.44) by Analog Africa Because of the era from which this music dates, it�s not surprising that the recording and instrument tones have changed - the guitars have a plastic sheen and synthesizers appear- even if the music remains rooted in the 1970s. Perhaps the influence of the Cuban son is more apparent here than on other Poly-Ritmo collections, especially in the collection�s initial offerings. And yes, Congolese rumba, then shaking all of sub-Saharan Africa to its knees, is present too. �Ma Won Min Towe Leo� is one example. Opening with a bed of synthesizers, the shimmering guitars, tinny, seemingly squeezed dry by the 80s themselves, lock in over relentless high-hat-focused grooves. The guitars finally start firing in different directions midway through, before that synth weaves back in, forming a bed underneath it all. Antoine Dougb� et L'Orchestre Poly-Rythmo De Cotonou 1977 - 1982 (Analog Africa No.44) by Analog Africa �We Tayi Sin Assi Tche� is much more overtly Cuban. With its insistent cowbell, classic, nasal vocal call and response, and tight, repeated guitar figures, its debt to mid-twentieth century Afro-Cuban sons is transparent. Another track, �Djomido Ma Dougbe Tche� rides a groove reminiscent of 70�s-era Franco classic �Liberte.� The pulse is relentless, and the guitar solo repeats a tight repetition of a few notes, driving listeners to ecstasy all the while. However, none of this music is a mere copy of its influences; rather, like so much potent pop coming from the continent at the time, it is a swirl of major influences rendered by local rhythms and vocal phrasing to give it specific identity, in this case, to Benin. Dougb�s musical role on this collection is a bit murky. One of his three albums has a photo of him, fully mic�d behind a collection of hand drums, so perhaps he served as a percussionist/vocalist; this release never explains. He wasn�t a songwriter in the traditional sense. It seems he was more of an instigator and arranger, but his thumbprint was apparently heavy enough to warrant his name on the records he was involved with. Whatever the case, in his brief run as a recording artist, he and Poly-Ritmo produced a handful of driving, Cavacha-inspired grooves that can still wear holes in club floors. Further reading: Petrona Mart�nez - Ancestras (Review) Gnonnas Pedro & His Dadjes - Roi De L'Agbadja Moderne 1974-1983 (Review)

items._genre: world fusion / afro-funk / afro-cuban / benin traditional / vodun
items._cn_summary: Analog Africa 第44号发行，收录贝宁传奇音乐人Antoine Dougbé与Orchestre Poly-Rythmo于1977至1982年的合作录音。Dougbé以拍击大腿演绎Cavacha节奏闻名，被称为"魔鬼首相"，同时精通伏都教仪式，创作观念具有强烈的精神属性。专辑音乐以萨托与萨克帕塔为根基，融合刚果伦巴、古巴颂乐及Benin本土传统律动，合成器与电吉他音色带有鲜明的八十年代初特征，部分曲目开篇以合成器铺底，吉他律动在高帽节奏中穿梭盘旋。评论指出此辑较此前几张Poly-Ritmo合辑更明显地暴露古巴影响，录音年代的演变体现在乐器配器与混音质感上。由Analog Africa这类专注挖掘非洲冷门律动的独立小厂牌发掘，具有不可复制的跨文化与地区稀缺性。

items.body: Tako Toki are like desert island musicians who, castaway without their instruments, were forced to construct their own. Lucky for us, they are as skilled in making instruments as they are in creating original songs with which to show off their handicrafts. Un Dimanche � Monaco is the band�s follow-up to their well-received debut, Hirsute Farfelus , with a similar mash of musical styles. Before discussing the music, we need to talk about their instrument closet. They really have built everything they play out of bric-a-brac, odds and ends, and rubbish. I�m not sure from listening which is which, but they call their instruments, in an incomplete list, tassofons, tilofons, and tubofones, clarinuts, didjerimou, and klarbass, and my favorite, kitchenofon. (I will refer to what I hear by the names of store-bought instruments that they sound like.) The most surprising thing for me was how accurate the instruments were to pitch and how good they sounded under the harsh scrutiny of modern recording microphones that have documented a rich, high-quality sound. UN DIMANCHE A MONACO - LP by Tako Toki They have also very effectively matched their choice of instruments with the style of music that inspires their compositions. Right off the top, �Yinitza� features a laughing clarinet singing a klezmer tune accompanied by bassoon for the bass, frantic two-time percussion, and the exuberant human yelps found on many klezmer recordings. As on this track, many tunes feature improvisations that show an impressive degree of musicianship. On the cumbia-inspired �Le Cuenta,� the characteristic flute carries the tune, augmented by a Spanish singing chorus, and remarkably rich-sounding Latin percussion. The title track surrounds us with afrobeat woodblocks, shakers, and rattles scattered around the mix. The melody is played on a marimba ornamented with bells and cymbals. Again, the lead player improvises over the tune and often against the beat with jazzy chops. The flute returns on the samba-inspired �Ambiguidade,� and on �Aksum� it traces a trance-like Middle Eastern tune reminiscent of a 60s TV spy-show theme. UN DIMANCHE A MONACO - LP by Tako Toki Full of fun and one of a kind, Un Dimanche � Monaco celebrates our universal love of rhythmic, melodic, and harmonic sounds and the varied, wonderful ways cultures have organized that love in what we call music. At the same time, playing on literal pieces of junk, Tako Tiko reminds us, as we contemplate many mall music shops filled with gleaming wood and brass instruments and countless unused guitars lying in closets, that musicians will always find a way to make music. Find the artist online. Further reading: Tako Toki - Hirsute Farfelus (Review) Terje Isungset - Glacial Poetry (Review)

items._cn_summary: Tako Toki 乐队以废弃杂物自制乐器为核心概念，tassofons、kitchenofon 等自创名称的乐器在现代录音下展现出精准的音高与丰富质感。专辑延续前作风格，将克莱兹默、昆比亚、桑巴、非洲节拍与中东旋律编织在一起，每种风格都匹配了相应的自制乐器组合：单簧管模拟克莱兹默配以巴松与急促打击乐；长笛引领拉丁曲目；木琴与铃铛构建非洲节奏段落。即兴段落贯穿全作，乐手展现出爵士化的技巧与多文化语境下的即兴能力。专辑在欢快基调下探讨了音乐的普世性与乐器的本质——即使只能获取碎片与废弃物，音乐仍然可以被创造出来。小型独立厂牌发行，整体呈现出罕见的跨文化实验特质。

items.body: After the extra-terrestial explorations of Eventyrferd , the previous album from Norway's Camilla Hole Trio, in which sci-fi synth sounds were married with traditional material, their latest release Langs is rather more earthbound. But the quest to look beyond their own country's folk music continues. Camilla Hole's main instrument being the soprano sax, the influence of jazz is unsurprising and this is evident in the opening track �Springleik,� signifying a tune used to accompany the springleik dance from the west of Norway. Initially Hole takes the melody with Egil Kalman and Knut Kvifte Nesheim providing rhythmic support on double bass and drums respectively, with the overdubbing of Kalman's modular synth and Nesheim's vibraphone adding colour. But characteristically for this trio, in which assigned roles are never clearly defined or adhered to, things soon start to move around, with Kalman taking up the melody on his bass, playing the melody in unison with Hole, while Nesheim opens things out further rhythmically. As the whole piece takes on a much more improvisatory feel, Hole plays the melody one more time as things draw to a close. Langs by Camilla Hole Trio
items.label: Taragot
items._cn_summary: 这是挪威Camilla Hole Trio继前作探索科幻合成器与民间素材结合之后的全新专辑，比前作更回归大地。三人组合以Soprano Sax为核心，融合低音提琴、鼓、模块化合成器与颤音琴，对挪威西部传统春之舞伴奏曲进行重新诠释。乐评详细拆解开篇曲的层次结构：主奏乐器提供旋律框架，节奏组以低音和鼓铺设律动基底，叠加合成器与颤音琴扩展音色空间；随着即兴段落的展开，固定角色不断流动转换，低音提琴手接过旋律与萨克斯齐奏，鼓手进一步打开节奏张力，最终由萨克斯收回主题收束。整张专辑延续了对本土民间音乐之外可能性的探索，以爵士语汇为桥梁，将传统旋律置于自由即兴的语境之中，呈现出有机且持续变化的演奏逻辑。

items._cn_summary: 这是西班牙吉他手 Dani Jané 的第三张专辑，融合弗拉门戈、加泰罗尼亚民谣、古典、爵士及世界音乐元素。Jané 毕业于巴塞罗那 Liceu 高等音乐学院，并在西班牙、德国、法国、意大利及印度深造，跨文化学习背景为其创作奠定基础。专辑核心由吉他、长笛、打击乐与电子效果构成四人编制，辅以弗拉门戈人声、贝斯与鼓。作品包括柏林时期创作的古典组曲，吉他与惠特曼诗歌西班牙语译文的 bulerías 段落交织；怀祖父之作以1938年歌词配合伦巴；致敬家乡卡恩·菲内斯特雷斯的 milonga；以及结尾受加泰罗尼亚吉他手 Toti Soler 影响的 tanguillos，吉他与长笛对话间点缀近似南印度卡纳提克节奏的人声打击。整张专辑展现了新一代加泰罗尼亚学院派艺术家在弗拉门戈之外广泛汲取养分的面貌。

items.body: sMiLes by Jowee Omicil B orn in Montreal, Haitian-Canadian musician-composer Jowee Omicil plays a fabulous variety of saxophones, clarinets, trumpets, flutes, piano, and keyboards. He came of age in the choral milieu of his father�s Montreal congregation, studied saxophone and music education at Berklee, and gleaned much from engagement with figures including Wyclef Jean, Tony Allen, Ibrahim Maalouf, Roy Hargrove, Kenny Garrett, Pharoah Sanders, Branford Marsalis, and Marcus Miller among others. Over the course of 2025, Omicil released sMiLes one song per month, each accompanied by a philosophizing podcast. The album opens with a striking reinterpretation of singer and Civil Rights activist Abbey Lincoln�s �Throw It Away,� whose message Omicil invokes in his voiceover, an expression of kinship in creative philosophical outlook. (For good measure, Omicil revisits the title on a distinctive �Throw it Away - FuLL oF LoVe Remix.�) Lincoln�s own 2007 rendition on Abbey Sings (Verve) offers critical context, itself worth a comparative audition for the original melody and the contemplative character of her lyrics. Throw it away, throw it away Give your love, live your life, each and every day And keep your hand wide open, let the sun shine through, Because you can never lose a thing, if it belongs to you. In less accomplished hands, the quirky sampling, effects, instrumentation, and wide-ranging, scruffy, sonic bricolage of sMiLes could make for one muddy m�lange. But no danger lies here in Jowee�s paradoxical, provocative, sound-shifting extended groove. Omicil's voice and sax blend almost imperceptibly in �SOeuR FeLiX AKA BeeHive.� In �Trip to GHanA,� polyrhythm meets wah-tone high-life guitar, cackly sax, and wordless vocalise. sMiLes by Jowee Omicil sMiLes by Jowee Omicil Feat. Mawuena Kodjovi Other titles transport the listener to Haiti, Morocco, Cape Verde, Jupiter, and Mali. �LeTTre Du MALi PouR JonaTHan� is a meditative, revelatory piano solo nearly ten minutes in length. sMiLes by Jowee Omicil sMiLes may invoke the free-blowing spirit of Miles (as on the sound-effected �MiLes ConvoY�), but there is no anxiety of influence here. Far from a rote genuflection to musical antecedents, the prevailing voice throughout is purely Omicil�s. As he counsels, �trust the note.� "Seek for the sound that is within you and the [instrument] will drive you to your destination� the singularity of sound is what I have always been searching for, the sound that comes from the heart, the sound that maybe, perhaps, is only heard in nature, this is what we are looking for when we are talking about sound� deep down, heartfelt uniqueness, always connected with the spirits�" - Jowee Omicil In accord with his music education formation, Omicil also leads music workshops through his BasH! AkademY, �a close-knit setting embracing spontaneity, authenticity, and shared growth,� which in 2025 included �a nomadic music experience traveling the world� to Mindelo, Cabo Verde. In 2026 Omicil will perform in New York, Canada, Martinique, France, Germany, Austria, Poland, Romania, the UK, and an African tour in the planning stage.

items._cn_summary: 海地裔加拿大音乐家Jowee Omicil在2025年以每月一首的形式发行专辑，融合萨克斯、钢琴与多文化元素，跨越海地、摩洛哥、佛得角、加纳、马里等地缘线索。开场以Abbey Lincoln《Throw It Away》的重新诠释奠定沉思基调，配合哲学性语音播客拓展作品维度。制作采用拼贴式采样、效果处理与多变音色，在保持自由吹奏精神的同时构建出层次复杂的声景。多首作品将复节奏与高音吉他、人声无歌词吟唱结合，钢琴独奏段落接近十分钟，探索声音的本源与个性表达。专辑在小厂牌Bandcamp发行，具有实验性的跨界融合气质，对学院派爵士与世界音乐听众具有较强吸引力。

items.body: The Visit by cris derksen The Visit isn�t an album built on compromises. The fourth release from Derksen, a Canadian from the North TallCree Reserve on her father�s side, and with a Mennonite lineage from her mother, pushes and cajoles her visions, where it�s the opening, full-throated improvisation of �White Gladis 1� (with singer Jennifer Kreisberg) or the encompassing haunting mood that grows up around �Lyre Birds.� She�s primarily a cellist, one who works across genres; one of the great joys here is it�s impossible to attach any kind of handle to the music. Just as you think you have it nailed down, the next track is something different, as with the the cello and programming of �aabaakwad� which becomes the wordless singing of �New Heya.� The Visit by cris derksen There�s a raw, unfettered beauty to the album, music made with passion and no restraints. There are a couple of songs here, but nothing that conforms to expectations, altering gears and direction, as when the strings and brass that arrive from nowhere to take over �Buffalo Girls.� The Visit by cris derksen But the emotional centrepiece here is �Lyre Birds,� with Derksen�s cello weaving sparely around the shards of spoken words, leading into the fluttering piano arpeggios of �Nice And Clean.� This is an album of surprises, leading down strange lanes and around brilliant corners that offer startling new views. As both composer and musician, Cris Derksen is more than a singular talent; she�s a person with a vision for her music, and she keeps true to it here. The Visit is not an easy listen, but it is eminently satisfying. Find the artist online. Further listening: Liz Hanks - Land Abel Selaocoe - Where Is Home (Hae Ke Kae) The Henrys - Shrug An audio interview with Cris Derksen from The Canadian Music Centre: Prairie Region hosted by Janna Sailor

items._cn_summary: 加拿大原住民与门诺派混血大提琴家Cris Derksen的第四张专辑拒绝任何标签。大提琴主轴贯穿全作，跨越古典、即兴、电子编程与世界音乐多个领域，每一曲都在变换方向：自由呐喊的开场、弦乐与铜管突如其来介入、钢琴琶音与口语碎片交织。她以作曲家和演奏者的双重身份贯彻个人美学，作品不迎合既有框架，呈现出未加修饰的原始力量。专辑不轻易消化，但情感层次丰厚，从大段即兴到器乐编制实验，均体现明确的艺术主张。原住民文化背景为作品注入独特视角，跨界姿态使其在当代古典与世界音乐交叉地带找到独特定位。

items.body: A Yorùbá chant to Ajé, the spirit of wealth and commerce, opens OKAN‘s new single “Ajé (Owó Nlá Nlá)” before a house beat takes hold. The Cuban duo made it with Miami producer FrankPal, who handed them the track’s starting idea, and they layer chanted Yorùbá vocals and percussion over his production. Elizabeth Rodriguez and Magdelys Savigne started OKAN, their Afro-Cuban project, in Toronto in 2017 and now run it from South Florida. Rodriguez trained as a classical violinist in Havana and held the concertmaster’s chair in the city’s youth orchestra; Savigne grew up in Santiago de Cuba and took honours in orchestral percussion at the University of the Arts. They are married, both Grammy and Latin-Grammy nominees, and two-time Juno winners whose 2023 album Okantomi took the global music award. The pair take their name from the Santería word for heart, and their songs have mostly tracked immigration, resistance and queer love. “Ajé (Owó Nlá Nlá)” turns toward abundance: not money alone, but family, health, creativity and spiritual fulfilment, framed through a feminine lens. The refrain “Àjẹ́ wá mí wá o” asks for that abundance to reach the singer and the house she lives in. The single arrived on 19 June, Juneteenth, the date in 1865 when news of emancipation finally reached enslaved people in Galveston, Texas, more than two years after it had been declared. Putting it out that week, the duo tie the song’s prosperity to freedom and African heritage, and step further into the Yorùbá tradition their music keeps reaching for. Stream “Ajé (Owó Nlá Nlá)” HERE. The post Daily Discovery: OKAN – Ajé (Owo Nla Nla) appeared first on Rhythm Passport.

items._cn_summary: 这张单曲将古巴音乐家的古典训练背景与非洲约鲁巴传统相结合。伊丽莎白·罗德里格斯曾任哈瓦那青年乐团首席小提琴，玛格德利斯·萨维涅在圣地亚哥成长，攻读管弦打击乐专业。两人2017年在多伦多创立OKAN，将非洲-古巴音乐传统延展至南佛罗里达，作品题材涉及移民、抗议与酷儿之爱。这首单曲以约鲁巴语对财富女神Ajé的吟唱开篇，叠加迈阿密制作人FrankPal提供的浩室节拍，呼唤富足——不仅是金钱，更涵盖家庭、健康、创造力和精神层面的圆满，并特别以女性视角呈现。发布时间选在六月十五日的六月节，将音乐的繁荣意象与解放、黑人传统紧密相连，是两人向约鲁巴传统深入探索的又一步。

items.body: Spanish producer DJ Moderno self-released “Dark Sessions Vol. I”, a five-track mashup album that reworks post-punk and new wave songs through UK garage and contemporary electronic production, on 1 July 2026 on Bandcamp. The set is the work of Germán Ormaechea, an independent DJ and producer from Spain. Each track pairs a source song with a club-facing electronic counterpart: “The Killing Diamond” sets Echo & The Bunnymen against Overmono, “Nowhere Girl on the Floor” pairs B-Movie with Jamie xx, “Lost in the Disko” combines The Cure, BICEP and Shiny Toy Guns, “Swamp Thing vs Chemtrails” places The Chameleons alongside Beck, and “She’s in Parties vs Hope” runs Bauhaus into Alex Metric. DJ Moderno describes the album as “exclusive reinterpretations of post-punk and new wave classics through the lens of UK Garage and contemporary electronic music,” mastered for DJ use and issued with WAV and MP3 downloads. Dark Sessions Vol. I by DJ MODERNO DJ Moderno’s ‘Dark Sessions Vol. I’ and the reinterpretation approach The producer cites Bicep, Jamie xx, Overmono and Fred again.. as reference points for the electronic side of the reworks, and describes the project as new electronic versions built to keep the atmosphere of the originals rather than straight mashups. Alongside the album, DJ Moderno has issued a separate standalone reinterpretation that combines Front 242’s “Headhunter” with “¿Quién mató a Laura Palmer?” by the Spanish electronic act Megabeat, a former Front 242 support act in Spain. About DJ Moderno DJ Moderno is the alias of Germán Ormaechea, an independent DJ and producer based in Spain who self-releases club edits, remixes and mashups through his Bandcamp page. His catalogue collects dancefloor reworks of pop, electronic and alternative material rather than original compositions. “Dark Sessions Vol. I” is presented as the first volume in a series and gathers his post-punk and new wave reinterpretations, released on 1 July 2026.

items.body: Shadowlands festival will hold its first edition from 1 to 4 July 2027 at the Gulbenkian Arts Centre in Canterbury, England. The four-day event covers alternative, electronic, avant-garde and experimental music, and its opening line-up features Foetus, Lustmord, Test Dept, Clock DVA, The Wolfgang Press, Githead, Regis, Portion Control, :Zoviet*France:, hackedepicciotto, People Like Us and Warrington-Runcorn New Town Development Plan, among others. The event is co-founded by David Sefton, who launched the Meltdown festival in 1993. Early-bird tickets are on sale, and further acts are due to be announced in August. Initial line-up for the Shadowlands festival JG Thirlwell’s Foetus tops the first wave. Thirlwell will perform as a 20-piece chamber orchestra in what the organisers describe as a European exclusive and his first UK appearance as Foetus in more than 25 years. The set draws on “HALT”, the final Foetus album released in December 2025, alongside earlier material. The announcement bills it as only the second time this music has been presented in a large orchestral format. Two other acts return after long absences. Lustmord plays a UK stage for the first time in almost two decades, while Githead – Colin Newman of Wire, Malka Spiegel of Minimal Compact and Robin Rimbaud, who records as Scanner – reunite after a 13-year break. Several of the booked artists have featured in recent Side-Line coverage. Clock DVA appear months after issuing a remastered “Thirst” for the album’s 45th anniversary on The Grey Area of Mute. Test Dept, who collected early studio and live recordings on the 2025 box set “Industrial Overture”, also join the bill. The Wolfgang Press, who announced the album “Asylum Variations” in June for release on Downwards, also feature. The rest of the first announcement gathers Regis with Liam Andrews, Portion Control, :Zoviet*France:, hackedepicciotto, People Like Us, Warrington-Runcorn New Town Development Plan, Ex-Easter Island Head, Immersion, Nad Spiro, Benedict Drew, Riotmiloo, Shape Navigator and Sophie Sirota, with more names due in August 2026. Dates, venue and tickets for Shadowlands festival The festival runs across three performance spaces at the Gulbenkian Arts Centre, on the University of Kent campus in Canterbury. Alongside live sets, the programme includes panel discussions, Q&As and a film strand. The organisers cap the event at 450 tickets and offer on-site accommodation, bookable from September 2026. 1-4 July 2027 – Canterbury, England – Gulbenkian Arts Centre, University of Kent Early-bird tickets cost £240, with the option to split the cost into three monthly payments; standard tickets are £280. Tickets are sold through the Gulbenkian, and further details are published on the official Shadowlands festival website. About Shadowlands festival Shadowlands is co-founded by David Sefton, former Head of Artistic Development at the Royal Festival Hall and South Bank Centre in London. Sefton launched the Meltdown festival in 1993, the annual event programmed each year by a single guest curator, and later ran UCLA Live in Los Angeles and the Adelaide Festival in Australia before becoming Artistic Director of the Gulbenkian Arts Centre in 2021. Shadowlands is the first full UK festival he has launched since Meltdown, and the organisers describe its remit as “The Outside Of Everything”. Sefton describes the festival as a home for artists working outside current trends rather than a platform for new names. “The idea is to bring something new to the festival landscape that is genuinely original,” he stated. “There are many great independent events in the UK, but all to an extent are tied into a ‘next big thing’ pattern. However, there are so many extraordinary artists out there who are as unique and exciting as the day they started, whether six months ago or forty years ago. Shadowlands is all about them.” With the first names confirmed and further additions promised for August, the Canterbury debut sets the template for how Shadowlands intends to build its programme.
items._cn_summary: 本文并非传统意义上的乐评，而是一篇音乐节新闻稿，介绍Shadowlands音乐节将于2027年7月在英格兰坎特伯雷Gulbenkian艺术中心首度举办，为期四天，涵盖另类、电子、前卫与实验音乐。阵容包括Foetus以20人室内乐团形式呈现欧洲独家演出、Lustmord近二十年首次英国舞台亮相、Githead时隔13年重组，以及Clock DVA、Test Dept、The Wolfgang Press、Portion Control、:Zoviet*France:、hackedepicciotto等艺人。音乐节由曾创办Meltdown的David Sefton联合创立，设有现场演出、座谈、问答和电影单元，限量450张门票并提供住宿。文章内容为新闻报道性质，缺乏对音乐本身的深度评论与艺术分析，但所涉及的艺人阵容与用户关注的前卫、工业、电子、暗潮领域高度吻合。

items._cn_summary: 1987年荷兰地下厂牌Nihilistic Recordings发行的磁带合辑，收录多位欧洲地下音乐人的工业与实验声响作品。曲目风格跨度较大，从硬核工业噪音到暗潮氛围皆有涉及，包括Big City Orchestra、Merz等知名地下艺术家的作品。Enema Syringe等曲目呈现北欧暗潮特有的冷峻质感，部分作品运用磁带拼接与现场录音的手法探索声音边界。作为上世纪八十年代欧洲地下工业场景的文献，合辑本身具有史料价值，但因是合辑形式，曲目风格杂糅，整体艺术连贯性有限。厂牌定位极端地下，发行量稀少，是工业/暗潮收藏者研究早期欧洲实验场景的重要参照。

items.body: Review by Fercandio46 — The best of the 90s indie spirit, which would resurface in the early 2000s, can be heard in the Japanese trio Miaou, formed by sisters Mayumi and Hiromi Hasegawa (on bass, synthesizer, and Rhodes, and drums, respectively) alongside Tatsuki Hamasaki on guitar, synthesizer, and programming. It is a perfect blend of technology and rock, infused with a melancholic, pastoral spirit that evokes the films of Wes Anderson and Sofia Coppola or the literature of Michel Houellebecq... until the deafening, distorted reality of the guitar erupts, like a curtain being drawn back to let the heart catch its breath.There are echoes of The Breeders in "Muno," the opening track, as well as Sonic Youth in "Boom", along with those calm guitars that recall endless afternoons spent with friends, where the future simply doesn't exist because one isn't even aware of it. And then comes that maelstrom, the centrifugal tunnel that sucks us in with its electric force.The drums even flirt with a jazz feel, without actually being jazz, as they accompany the guitar; yet, there is a clear desire to transcend, one that reaches beyond the music itself.Pao 2000 offers a pleasant surprise with a syncopated, uptempo funk sound that borders on rock; when the trio kicks into gear, it's like a perfect engine starting up, with every part turning in unison.The trio is fully capable of exploring a range of tonal colors and moods, revealing along the way that there is melody, harmony, and contrast, and, in the case of El Nienyo, virtuosity devoid of self-indulgence. The guitar work of Sonic Youth's Thurston Moore and Kim Gordon, an iconic duo that made history and paved the way for Grunge, seems well-matched here by Tatsuki Hamasaki and Mayumi Hasegawa in Kirameki; they achieve those frenetic, driving passages that then settle into semi-jazzy drum rhythms... like watching tree branches fly by from a car window."Jet Sound Wave" sounds like Fripp's Frippertronics mixed with a trumpet, featuring accompanying drum hits and a languid vocal that, rather than simply singing, seems to drag the music along with it. It is almost reminiscent of Nico with The Velvet Underground, undoubtedly another influence on the trio.Half-awakening from the slumber, recalling Veruca Salt, to continue on an independent path, until the expansive "Water & Me" evokes the sweetness of "Sunday Morning," only to drift away completely... the guitar playing disjointed notes... the trumpet... before finally pulling themselves back together, as if it were a fairy tale that didn't dare end badly.
items._genre: post-rock / math rock / indie / experimental rock
items._cn_summary: MIAOU由两姐妹Mayumi和Hiromi Hasegawa加上吉他手Tatsuki Hamasaki组成，将九十年代独立精神带入两千年代。专辑将Lo-fi技术与摇滚融合，以忧郁的田园气质铺陈出舒缓的吉他织体与朦胧人声，随后突然切入失真噪音的爆发段落，形成静谧与暴烈之间的强烈张力。鼓击在沉稳推进中偶尔流露出爵士律动的暗示，吉他演奏则在Sonic Youth式自由噪音与精控技术之间穿梭。曲目如"Jet Sound Wave"借鉴Frippertronics循环技法配合小号般音色，"Water & Me"则从甜美的晨光氛围滑入破碎的解构尾声。整体呈现出在旋律框架内进行情绪爆破的尝试，技术扎实但未完全脱离常规独立摇滚的审美逻辑。

items.body: Review by Sean Trane — Weird second (but double) live album that featured nothing from their first official album (NewDawn) and plenty from their previous private live tapes. Graced with an archeological artwork,Entangled Scorpio Entrance is very much a needed early Tangle Edge item, because if 2/3 of thefuture Eulogy studio release is on the first disc, much of the rest is either from those earlyprivate cassette releases or simply unavailable elsewhere. In terms of music, we're drastically different from the New Dawn album, and while remainingpredominantly psychedelic, there is a big King Crimson influence, notably the Collins/Burrell/Wallace line-up. For that matter, it's relatively hard not to think about Earthbound or otherrecordings from that line-up, with much improvisations - and obviously no wind instruments and ofcourse no vocals, since the band chose to be 100% instrumental (we don't even hear introductionspeeches between tracks). As with Earthbound, the sonics are approximate, victim of the energy.Just in case you're interested, 2026 sees a CD reissue of Entangled Scorpio Entrance on CD (as itwas in 92), as the original issue had become quite rare. As for the essential nature of this album,it will depend much on how you feel about the band's live presence on stage. While I like itenouigh, I don't think it'sd essential.
items._genre: psychedelic rock / space rock / progressive rock / instrumental / improvisation
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑是乐队第二张现场双唱片，但未收录首张正式专辑的作品，主要取材于早期的私人现场磁带。音乐风格以迷幻摇滚为主，并显著受到King Crimson（尤其Collins/Burrell/Wallace时期）影响，呈现大量即兴段落。乐队刻意选择全器乐路线，不加入任何管乐和人声，曲目之间也无任何介绍性言语，与Earthbound等现场录音气质相近。录音质感粗粝，保留了现场的能量感但牺牲了一定音质。专辑包含了部分后来Eulogy专辑的雏形素材，其余内容多为独家呈现。由于原始发行已较为稀少，2026年将有CD再版。整体而言，它是乐队早期生涯中重要的考古式记录，但对现场氛围的接受程度将决定其对听众的必要性。

Vilma delivers austere, solemn, icy vocals before Joni's heavy guitar solo kicks in. The sound recalls a heavier Spriggan Mist, driven by a haunting, persistent flute. "To Be Led by the Lost" is a dark ballad where the flute softens the mood; mantra-like vocals introduce a cinematic track?a martial Southern folk-rock piece featuring Jarmo's trumpet. Warm male vocals play over a deep, muffled drumbeat; a nostalgic, vibrant, low-register guitar casts doubt on the genre. Vilma's voice heightens the solemnity, launching "A Thought" atop a deep bassline and a melancholic violin, amplified by heavy, gothic vocals. A crescendo builds with a solemn Western-style guitar and deep, unique Mellotron-esque soundscapes that send a chill down the spine. "The Word" leans fully into the "Spaghetti Western" vibe?an inventive, wild folk-country instrumental with elegiac backing vocals and a rhythm worthy of Morricone scoring a Metallica concert intro. A piercing synth and trumpet kick in, giving me goosebumps; there's a Floydian touch with the bass and "ooh-ha-ooh" backing vocals?I am utterly spellbound."Oldest Father" delivers a sad, religious, dark-folk sound. It carries a hint of Nordagust fused with the theme music from the French crime show *Faites Entrer l'Accus�*, creating a cold, hypnotic, and repetitive atmosphere. "The First Casualty" shifts into tribal Indian-electro mode?a cinematic soundtrack for... a Western, featuring expertly used trumpet. An electric guitar?acting as an interlude against a backdrop of sweeping backing vocals?introduces "Crystal Waters of Spring," driven by a metronomic hang drum and the swirling, crisp sound of an Indian flute. It is yet another folk-style crescendo in the vein of Lunatic Soul, though more colorful, fresh, and resplendent. A 60s-style guitar?reminiscent of a gangster movie soundtrack?layered over warm backing vocals lends an astonishing warmth to this unclassifiable, untamable track.Ons�gen Ensemble releases an exhilarating folk concept album that flirts with psychedelic fusion and hard rock, traversing ethereal, Western, contemplative, and desolate landscapes.(4.5)

items.body: Der Australier Griffin James beweist: Das kann doch jede*r. Bevor gleich der Vorwurf eines vergifteten Kompliments die Runde macht, soll eine Erklärung nachgeschickt werden. Griffin hat als Sans Merit auch auf seinem zweiten Album vielleicht nicht die wertigsten Gerätschaften um sich versammelt, um seinen noisigen Bedroom-Dream-Pop aufzunehmen, und braucht dafür auch nicht die größten oder plakativsten Melodien. Gemeint ist: In der Musik selbst, zwischen den Tönen und im Detail steckt das, was sie auszeichnet. Und das, was letztlich alles ist, was sich dort zu suchen lohnt. Das Wie als Antwort auf das Was. Es ist zu wissen, dass die klingelnden Gitarren in »The End« etwas lauter bleiben müssen als der Gesang, der hier eher als Fläche genutzt wird. Es ist zu wissen, dass das ausladende Intro im The-Cure-meets-DIIV-Hit »Civil« einen so hypnotischen Sog erzeugt, dass er das Ganze lieber länger laufen lässt, als man zu Beginn denken würde. Griffin James ist jemand, der dir – okay, dramatisieren wir ein bisschen – vermutlich auch auf einer Blechdose und mit einem Taschenrechner die fuzzy Noise-Pop-Hits der Saison zusammenschraubt, die in seinen Händen mehr als die Summe ihrer einzelnen Teile sein dürfen.

items._cn_summary: 澳大利亚音乐人格里芬·詹姆斯以Sans Merit为名发表第二张专辑，走的是卧室录音的噪音梦幻流行路线。评论指出这张作品并不依赖昂贵的设备或引人入胜的旋律取胜，而是将注意力放在音乐本身发生的过程——声音之间的细节与质感。吉他被有意调得比人声更响，人声作为音色的铺垫层而非传统的主线索；某些曲目的开场段落足够催眠，让人不自觉地延长聆听时间。评论人认为这位创作者即使只用罐头和计算器也能拼凑出当季最出色的迷雾噪音流行片段，因为制作方式本身是作品的核心。整体以质感层次和制作理念为卖点，是一张追求声音内部逻辑而非旋律记忆点的作品。

items.body: In the third volume of his ongoing series, Cédric Tiberghien dedicates over two hours exclusively to the piano variation. The album offers a thoughtfully curated program that sets Beethoven’s early classical structures directly against the rigorous, twentieth-century language of György Ligeti and György Kurtág. Variations Vol. 3 Amazon Presto Apple György Ligeti’s Musica Ricercata highlights Tiberghien’s natural affinity for contemporary music built upon mathematical structure and craft. While the cycle is organized by strict pitch classes and axes of symmetry, it continuously explores a surprising variety of musical forms. The pianist navigates this deliberate, precise compositional language with ease. The fiercely concentrated opening movement, focusing entirely on the pitch of A before resolving on a solitary D, relies on his dry tone and crystalline attacks to emphasize its minimalism. A delightful contrast arrives in the third movement, boasting a jazzy character rendered with meticulous clarity. When approaching the sparse textures and jarring dissonances of the Rubato Lamentoso, Tiberghien cultivates a wonderfully unsettled atmosphere. He allows the music to sound poignant and declaratory one moment, only to pull it back into a quiet, almost sinister shadow the next. Tiberghien’s choice to alternate between Beethoven and contemporary pieces not only highlights their stylistic differences but also offers the listener a welcome respite, as some of the modern fare can be challenging. Among the several WoO sets presented, the Six Variations on a Swiss Song are sunny, elegant, and delightful. The precision of the pianist’s articulation reveals an insightful connection to the Ligeti, reminding us of the latter’s distinct percussive profile. The Eight Variations on Une fièvre brûlante carry a disarming charm alongside moments of vivacity and virtuosity. The second variation gallops away with its arpeggios, while the third is reminiscent of someone skipping. Tiberghien introduces humor every time scales and two-note phrases bump into each other in a lightly awkward and off-kilter manner. The Twelve Variations on a Russian Dance exude a coy lyricism that greets the ears in the Theme and resurfaces in moments like the eighth variation, which is especially beautiful for its sustained, dulcet tone. Selections from György Kurtág‘s books of Játékok offer yet another avenue of moods and sound profiles. Almost all of these works are minimalistic and atmospheric, serving as intriguing palate cleansers between the perennially happy early Beethoven works. The sixth piece from the first book may be sandwiched between two sets of Beethoven variations, but it feels more like a fleeting postlude to the eerie conclusion of the Ligeti. Floating barely above a whisper, Tiberghien brings out the translucence of the overlapping notes. Achieving a similar gossamer profile, the twenty-fourth piece from the same book incorporates more complex harmonies and mixed resonances. Cédric Tiberghien. Photo © Simon Perry Reserving the Diabelli Variations as the album’s culminating work, Tiberghien illustrates just how skillfully Beethoven evolved the variation genre from light entertainment into a vehicle of profound complexity. His reading of the Theme not only highlights the comedy of Diabelli’s original tune but also brings a boisterous personality to the subito fortes that rudely interrupt the waltz. Despite this promising start, the remaining variations call for more vitality across the board. While he maintains the integrity of a wonderful tone and nuanced musicianship, this is a work that comes to life through its boldness. One example is the march of the first variation, where the dotted rhythms lack the pomp and circumstance found in Mitsuko Uchida’s acclaimed reading. Similarly, the Poco Allegro of the second variation feels too timid, and a little later, in the sixth variation, the overall character comes off as somewhat dry and removed. Towards the end of the work, the Fuga is well-controlled and reflects the precision heard elsewhere. The critical repeated-note motif, however, does not possess the dogged insistence that makes Alfred Brendel’s version so vibrant. Tiberghien is at his best in the most introspective moments, of which there are plenty. While his traversal of the Diabelli set may not replace primary recommendations, his curation makes the album rewarding for everything else it offers. items.body: Sad Lovers & Giants The Weight of Forgotten Dreams Voight-Kampff Records The Weight of Forgotten Dreams, the tenth album by Sad Lovers & Giants comes some eight years since the band’s first reactivation era LP Mission Creep, and finds the cult English post-punk act both dreamy and dismayed. Being downcast is of course nothing new for SLaGs, the band having cut their teeth on melancholia in their eighties heyday. And like their classic records, they make sure to spike the mopeyness with some proper big pop-leaning rockers, that keep things moving. That said, the weight of this record’s lyrical concerns often render it somber, even at its most energized. And to be clear, hearing a band of Sad Lovers & Giants address the state of the world is a good thing. And while there’s a certain awkwardness to some of the ways political and social issues are addressed, sincerity and commitment carry the day. On “Repentence Day” vocalist Garçe Allard intones “You tried to tell us how you’d make us great again/But we were great until you came” and starts the final verse with “Speaking to those in 2055/I hope that you’re all still alive”, sentiments could elicit a groan if they weren’t being sung by someone who deeply felt them. Alternately, there’s wryness at play that works to their advantage as well; they get away with invoking The Tempest into the chimey sing-song fantasy “Survival Plan”, and the album’s undoubted highlight “Think Like a Roman” goes all in on its central metaphor, dropping references to Horace and numerous latin aphorisms, all in service of a bright, uplifting guitar lick that sets the tone perfectly. And to their credit, the band sound tremendous here, as good as at any point in their now 40 plus year history. Garçe’s voice is as clean and clarion as ever, the guitars from Tony McGuinness (incidentally, a member of trance megastars Above & Beyond) strum and peel of riffs in lively fashion, and the rhythm section of Ian Gibson and Nigel Pollard sit right in the pocket, never overly flashy but always doing something to keep the songs moving along. Instrumental cuts “Sci-Fi Theme” and closer “Astolat” really do highlight their capacity to for good arrangements and ideas; the former revolving around a big swirly keyboard solo from synthesist Will Hicks, and the latter tying a bow on the LP’s elegiac feelings with an oboe of all things. It really is remarkable how close to a classic SLaGs record it all sounds from a production and songwriting standpoint, if not a bit cleaner and more hi-fi, although thankfully not overly glossy. Sad Lovers & Giants are a niche band in the world of dreamy post-punk, but their following is loyal and has kept the flame burning for them through numerous stops and stars over the decades. With that in mind, its hard to imagine anyone who has any investment in the band finding much fault with The Weight of Forgotten Dreams. It just sounds so perfectly like Sad Lovers & Giants in all ways, with all their sonic characteristics and their various instrumental and lyrical idiosyncrasies in effect. And despite being informed by our civilization’s alarmingly rapid decline, its constancy ends up being a comfort. Buy it. The post Sad Lovers & Giants, “The Weight of Forgotten Dreams” appeared first on I Die: You Die.
items._cn_summary: Sad Lovers & Giants 第十张录音室专辑，时隔八年再度发声，延续八十年代以来的忧郁气质，融合梦幻流行与后朋克的阴郁氛围。专辑在低沉情绪中穿插明亮的流行摇滚段落，以真诚的态度探讨政治与社会议题。歌词虽偶有笨拙之处，但情感真挚，同时夹杂莎士比亚《暴风雨》的引用和拉丁语箴言等文学化意象。主唱 Garçe Allard 嗓音清亮如昔，吉他编织富有活力，合成器与双簧管等乐器为器乐段落增添层次感。整体制作精良而不过度抛光，保持了乐队四十余年一贯的美学风格，是面向忠实乐迷的 niche 之作。

items.body: Cold Spring releases “Cafe OTO”, a live album by Keiji Haino and Steve Noble, on CD on 17 July 2026. The record documents a duo performance the two improvisers gave at Cafe OTO in London on 28 February 2012, and it is the first time that recording appears on a physical format. The concert previously circulated only as a digital release. Keiji Haino and Steve Noble’s ‘Cafe OTO’: a 2012 set across four movements For the CD, Cold Spring splits the roughly hour-long performance into four untitled parts, running from about twelve to eighteen minutes each. Haino plays electric guitar and feedback and, at one point, sets the guitar down for a wooden flute; Noble answers on a full percussion set-up. John Chantler recorded and mixed the show, and Martin Bowes of Attrition mastered it for Cold Spring, with sleeve design by Abby Helasdottir. The release comes as a CD in a matt digipak. The album is Side-Line’s first coverage of the pairing, and it lands close to another Cold Spring reissue of Japanese experimental music, Sun Ra | Merzbow ‘Strange City’. The label has drawn on the same well before, as with its vinyl reissue documented in Cold Spring reissues cult Japanese noise release by Maso Yamazaki on vinyl. About Keiji Haino and Steve Noble Keiji Haino, born in Chiba, Japan, in 1952, is an experimental musician who works across electric guitar, feedback, percussion, wind instruments and voice. He first turned to performance through theatre before forming the group Fushitsusha in 1978, and has since appeared on more than 200 recordings under his own name and with projects including Nazoranai and Sanhedrin. His playing moves between extreme volume and near-silence, often within a single piece. Steve Noble is a London-based drummer and percussionist active in free improvisation since the early 1980s, when he worked with Rip Rig + Panic and the Bow Gamelan Ensemble. He has recorded and performed with Derek Bailey, Peter Brötzmann and Stephen O’Malley, and leads the groups N.E.W. and Decoy. His work centres on the acoustic drum kit and extended percussion. Cold Spring, the UK label releasing “Cafe OTO”, has issued industrial, power electronics, dark ambient, noise and experimental music since 1988. Recorded at the Dalston venue Cafe OTO, which opened in 2008 as a home for improvised and experimental music, the album brings a long-unavailable Haino and Noble meeting to CD for the first time.
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑收录了灰野敬二与鼓手Steve Noble于2012年在伦敦Cafe OTO的现场即兴录音，由独立厂牌Cold Spring首次以CD形式发行。录音由John Chantler完成混音，Martin Bowes负责母带处理，时长约一小时，被拆分为四个无标题段落，每段约十二至十八分钟。演出中，灰野敬二在电吉他与反馈之间游走，并在某一刻放下吉他改吹木笛；Noble则以完整套鼓和扩展打击乐回应。两位即兴音乐人的互动呈现出极强音量与接近沉默之间的剧烈摆动，跨越数十年合作脉络。专辑以matt digipak形式推出，是Cafe OTO同类型日本实验音乐现场录音的延续，与Sun Ra与Merzbow的合作录音构成厂牌的相近发行序列。

items.body: Gnoomes have set a release date for “Losey”, the new album from the psych and electronic duo who formed in Russia and now live in Slovenia. “Losey” arrives on 4 September 2026 on Rocket Recordings, on vinyl and digital, and lands with a video for the title track and an autumn tour of the UK and Europe. It is the follow-up to 2023’s “Ax Ox”. Losey by Gnoomes Gnoomes are Sasha Piankov and his creative and life partner Masha Piankova, who left Russia for Slovenia and built most of the record at home. The drums were recorded by their former bandmate Pasha Fedoseev in Perm; the rest, in Sasha’s words, came together “without leaving the house.” The duo mix krautrock, shoegaze and electronics, and name Stereolab, Joy Division, Chris & Cosey and Paul McCartney among the reference points for the new songs. The digital album is sold through Bandcamp, with the vinyl available from Rocket Recordings, the UK label whose recent roster also includes The Utopia Strong’s “The Atavist”. The seven-track album runs from opener “Foreign Agent” through “May Night”, the title track “Losey”, “Repeat Repent”, “Shakshuka And Pie”, “Satan’s Ball” and “Crangonyx”. Piankov ties the move to the music itself: “The life of an immigrant is a strange thing, but luckily, that glow music brings us has never faded, even though the emotional landscape has definitely shifted. We often say that moving from Russia wasn’t just a political decision, it was a nervous system decision.” Gnoomes ‘Losey’ title track and video The title track, built around what the band call an “acid stomp,” takes its cue from Chris & Cosey, and the video was made by the duo from years of personal iPhone footage. Masha Piankova describes it as a walk through the moment before sleep: “It’s that strange threshold before sleep, when your brain is completely overloaded and reality begins to slip. Hallucinations, memories, nightmares, impossible landscapes, euphoric dance scenes, and dreams that blur the line between fear and desire all end up in the same room, dancing together until morning. It’s basically a glimpse inside my sleepless brain.” Gnoomes tour dates 2026 Gnoomes follow the album with a run of European and UK shows through autumn: 10 Sep 2026 – Ljubljana, Slovenia – Channel Zero 16 Oct 2026 – Budapest, Hungary – Niche 23 Oct 2026 – Padova, Italy – Nadir 24 Oct 2026 – Bologna, Italy – Bauhaus 30 Oct 2026 – Norwich, UK – The Holloway 03 Nov 2026 – Sheffield, UK – Delicious Clam 05 Nov 2026 – Newcastle, UK – Lubber Fiend 11 Nov 2026 – Bristol, UK – The Lanes 12 Nov 2026 – Northampton, UK – The Black Prince 13 Nov 2026 – London, UK – Strongroom Bar 20 Nov 2026 – Berlin, Germany – Arkaoda About Gnoomes Gnoomes formed in Perm, Russia, in 2014 as a trio of Sasha Piankov (vocals, bass), Pasha Fedoseev (drums) and Dima Koniushevich (guitar), with all three also playing synthesizers. The band described their sound as “stargaze”, a mix of krautrock, shoegaze and techno driven by motorik rhythms and pulsing electronics. Their first release was the cassette EP “It’s Moonbow-Time, Boy” on the Russian label Pikkalma Product in 2014, which drew the attention of the UK psychedelic label Rocket Recordings. Rocket issued the band’s debut album “Ngan!” on 16 October 2015, followed by “Tschak!” on 10 March 2017. Keyboardist Masha Piankova joined for “MU!”, released on 31 May 2019, expanding the group to a quartet. “Ax Ox”, released on 3 March 2023, was the first Gnoomes album sung entirely in Russian. The band later left Russia and relocated to Slovenia, continuing as the duo of Sasha Piankov and Masha Piankova. “Losey”, out on 4 September 2026 on Rocket Recordings, is their first album since that move.
items._cn_summary: 俄罗斯裔双人组合Gnoomes宣布将在Rocket Recordings发行新专辑《Losey》，融合了krautrock的律动感、shoegaze的音墙质感与电子元素。乐队由Sasha Piankov与Masha Piankova组成，二人从俄罗斯移居斯洛文尼亚后在家中完成了大部分录制工作，前乐队鼓手Pasha Fedoseev在彼尔姆录制了鼓的部分。七首曲目从开场曲《Foreign Agent》到结尾的《Crangonyx》，同名主打曲围绕乐队所谓的"酸性顿足"节奏展开，灵感来自Chris & Cosey。Piankov表示移民经历深刻影响了音乐创作，移居不仅是政治决定，更是神经系统层面的抉择。Masha将视觉内容描述为入睡前大脑超载时现实与幻觉交融的阈限体验。Masha将自制MV形容为失眠大脑的内部景观，融合幻觉、记忆与梦境。专辑将于2026年9月发行，并随后展开欧洲与英国巡演。

items.album: Cold Shoulder
items.excerpt: Oren Ambarchi and Will Guthrie reconvene for a killer, fully tooled-up fusion of organ-esque Leslie vamps, sitar-style twangs and Guthrie's Han Bennink-inspired full kit theatrics -...
items._cn_summary: Oren Ambarchi 与 Will Guthrie 再度合作的录音延续了两人对自由即兴与实验声响的探索。专辑以 Leslie 旋转喇叭效果处理吉他，营造出近似管风琴的低频共鸣与持续音，同时融入西塔琴式的弹拨音色与 Guthrie 受 Han Bennink 启发的全鼓组戏剧化演奏。整体呈现为一种器械化的融合形态，在极简循环、噪音质感与节奏张力之间不断切换，乐器之间形成密集而精密的对话。文本为简短摘录，虽信息有限，但所描述的声音设计明显指向实验即兴音乐的核心地带，对关注前卫与跨界即兴的听众具有参考价值。

items.album: False LP A
items.excerpt: Topdown Dialectic’s solo debut bow on False Aralia rounds up over a decade of material in supremely elusive style & pattern - all rug-pulling rhythms and hallucinatory fractals wrapped up...
items._genre: experimental electronic / abstract / glitch / ambient techno
items._cn_summary: Topdown Dialectic在False Aralias厂牌的首张个人专辑收录了十多年来的素材，以极其隐秘的方式呈现，融合了抽离人心的节奏模式与幻觉般的分形声响。整张专辑呈现出持续剥离与重构的质感，节拍如陷阱般反复转换，构成复杂而流动的声场结构。作品游离在抽象电子与氛围性techno之间，纹理细腻且具有催眠式的循环特征，碎片化的元素与重复模式相互交织，形成具有强烈沉浸感的聆听体验。专辑不依赖旋律或人声，而是依靠精密的节奏操控和声音处理来构建张力与空间感，体现出多年素材沉淀后高度凝练的美学取向。

items.album: Beton Brute OST
items.excerpt: One half of Rezzett, Jackson ‘Tapes’ Bailey reels off a lush new age ambient / environmental soundtrack primed for deep immersion, originally intended for his partner’s food sculpture...
items._cn_summary: Rezzett组合成员J Bailey以个人名义发布的氛围原声作品，最初为伴侣的食物雕塑创作。这张专辑以'深层沉浸'为核心目标，融合新世纪氛围与环境音概念，侧重于空间感和氛围铺陈而非旋律推进。作为跨界合作语境下的个人项目，它体现了创作者在组合之外的探索方向。Boomkat作为以实验电子和前卫音乐著称的独立平台，其推荐本身就指向了偏向实验和氛围品味的受众。由于原文信息较为有限，仅能确认其氛围性和沉浸式的创作意图，具体的声音设计细节和创新程度难以充分判断，整体定位偏向小众氛围电子领域。

items.album: Skeffu
items.excerpt: Nkalipho Andile Mkhize aka Akiid blazes thru with 11 sharp sidespins on gqom, ama & Afrotech, inflected with Jersey club, trance, trap and techno - all demonstrating why he’s one of...
items._genre: gqom / afrotech / electronic / jersey club / trance-techno
items._cn_summary: 南非制作人 Akiid 在这张专辑中以 gqom 和 ama-piano 为基底，融合了 Jersey club、trance、trap 与 techno 等多种俱乐部舞曲语言，呈现十首节奏驱动的电子舞曲作品。Akiid 将祖鲁文化的舞曲传统与当代俱乐部场景结合，延续了 Durban 电子舞曲场景的实验脉络。Boomkat 简介指出他在多种风格间灵活切换，但 excerpt 文字极为有限，仅提及曲风融合与制作人背景，未涉及具体作品的声响细节、编排逻辑或艺术理念，因此难以全面评估其创新深度。作为一位南非新兴制作人的长篇舞曲专辑，该作品在地域性和跨风格融合方面具有一定价值，但内容过短限制了对作品质量的深入判断。

items.album: Sub Zero - Refractions (The Bug / Ghost Dubs Remixes)
items.excerpt: Ghost Dubs & The Bug duppy the latter’s cult, isolationist ambient excursion of 2022 with apposite measures of lead-boot trod and atmospheric levity for the...
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑是对Kevin Richard Martin（原The Bug）2022年孤僻氛围专辑的混音再诠释，由Ghost Dubs与The Bug本人共同操刀。Ghost Dubs的版本呈现'铅靴踏压'式的深沉低音质感与氛围轻盈感并置，将原作的孤立主义氛围进一步推向dub的物理重量感。The Bug的混音则保留了标志性的低音驱动与压迫性频率处理。两组混音都以极简手法重新解构原素材，在留白与密度之间取得平衡。对于熟悉地下电子与dub制作语境的听众而言，这是一种对原专辑不同切面的探索，而非简单重制。整体仍属小众地下电子范畴，制作精细但缺乏足够文字描述来全面判断其创新程度。

items.album: Sowas von Egal 3 (German Synth Wave Underground 1981-86)
items.excerpt:
Bureau B compile stray new wave and NDW-adjacent bullets by overlooked ‘80s Austrian, Swiss, and German artists, including many making their first legit appearance.

The spiky drive...
items._genre: synth wave / new wave / NDW / minimal synth / post-punk
items._cn_summary: 德国厂牌 Bureau B 整理了 1981 至 1986 年间来自奥地利、瑞士与德国等地一批被忽视的地下艺术家作品，这些曲目长期未获正式发行机会，呈现出新潮运动与德国新潮（NDW）周边的合成器流行面貌。合辑聚焦于合成器驱动的冷峻节奏与棱角分明的编曲结构，收录了多位艺术家在该领域中被遗漏的首批正式亮相作品。从文字描述来看，这些曲目强调锐利的驱动感与极简主义合成器美学，融合了后朋克的紧张感与早期电子实验的探索意识。该合辑为研究德语区八零年代地下电子场景提供了难得的档案素材，但评论原文信息量有限，无法深入判断其中作品的创新程度与跨领域融合深度。

items.album: Magic Object
items.artist: Play Time (Ben Vida, Will Epstein and Booker Stardrum)
items.excerpt: Ben Vida breaks bread with in-demand percussionist Booker Stardrum and multi-instrumentalist Will Epstein on 'Magic Object', figuring out an "elastic" improv sound using Moog, sax and...
items._cn_summary: Ben Vida 与打击乐手 Booker Stardrum 及多乐器演奏家 Will Epstein 合作，在《Magic Object》中尝试构建一种「弹性」的即兴声响。三人以 Moog 合成器、萨克斯及打击乐器为核心，探索乐器之间的实时互动与即兴对话。专辑强调创作者之间的默契配合，而非预设的结构或作曲框架，声音在不同乐器之间游走、变形，形成流动的织体。这种做法延续了 Vida 在实验音乐领域的探索方向，融合电子音色与原声乐器的质感，试图在即兴演奏中寻找新的听觉可能性。整体呈现出当代实验音乐对跨媒介协作与声音探索的关注，适合对实验即兴与电子融合感兴趣的听众深入聆听。

items.album: Iseo
items.excerpt: Airbrushed, subtropical, new age ambient-jazz from Jesse Peterson’s Maui-based project, given its highest profile platform to date on Amsterdam’s Music From Memory...
items._cn_summary: Iseo 是 Jesse Peterson 在毛伊岛开展的音频项目，这张专辑在阿姆斯特丹独立厂牌 Music From Memory 发行，是其迄今曝光度最高的平台。专辑气质偏向亚热带氛围，将 new age 的松弛质感与即兴爵士的呼吸感融合在一起，营造出经过空气处理的柔和光泽。整体制作偏向环境音乐方向，听感轻盈通透，适合作为背景聆听。从厂牌风格来看，Music From Memory 历来关注被遗忘或边缘化的氛围、爵士与电子交叉地带作品，此张专辑延续了这一线索。评论文字较为简短，未能提供更多细节，但对于关注氛围与爵士融合场景的听众而言，这是一个值得关注的方向。

items.body:
I want to personally direct you to a remarkable piece of music titled "Two Views of a Prayer," composed and written by
David Dzubinski
as part of the
Prism Quartet
's new series of collaborations called
Unlocking Your Inner Composer
. If you have listened to my radio programs, you are probably familiar with the quartet's ground-breaking, genre-blurring music. If not, there's no better introduction than this.
Performed in November of 2025 at the Free Library of Philadelphia, they invited vocalist
Ursula Rucker
, percussionist
Tyshawn Sorey
, and violinist
Carlos Santiago
to collaborate on the arrangement and performance of Dzubinski's composition. It travels from raw to lyrical and back in the course of just under 4 minutes, with both finesse and energy. - Cliff Furnald, editor
Find Prism Quartet online.
items._genre: contemporary classical / chamber music / avant-garde jazz / spoken word / experimental
items._cn_summary: 作曲家David Dzubinski为Prism Quartet创作的《Two Views of a Prayer》是其"Unlocking Your Inner Composer"合作系列的一部分。作品于2025年11月在费城免费图书馆首演，邀请了人声表演者Ursula Rucker、打击乐手Tyshawn Sorey以及小提琴手Carlos Santiago共同参与编排与演出。萨克斯四重奏与人声、打击乐、小提琴的结合体现了跨界合作的思路。评论者Cliff Furnald指出，这首不到四分钟的短曲在粗粝与抒情之间快速往返，兼具细腻与张力。尽管文字篇幅较短，仅提供了概述性的描述，但涉及的演奏者阵容——尤其是自由爵士/即兴领域极具影响力的Tyshawn Sorey——暗示了作品的实验性走向。对于关注当代古典与先锋爵士交叉领域的听众而言，这是一次值得关注的小规模合作尝试。

items.body:
A debut, digital-only EP from a Danish trio, led by one of the Nordic folk scene�s outstanding and experienced vocalists, Mia Guldhammer. Five tracks, with the musicians bringing their own perspectives to mostly traditional music. There�s a lovely ancient, creaky mood throughout.
The opener, �Svennedal,� with its rough, cantering rhythm, offers a perfect shop window for Guldhammer�s impressive, persuasive voice, while jaw harp and bagpipes bring an insistent propulsion to �Nordg�rd,� the only original here, by band member Morten Musicus.
Cimbalom adds a delicate backdrop to the traditional �Agnete Of Bjergmanden,� with Guldhammer�s soft jaw harp offering extra textures to the other instruments, as it brings a springy opening to the final cut, �Orms�,� mingling with flute and strings to create something quite thrilling and off kilter on this instrumental.
Five tracks, and an introduction to a band that already seems very mature and accomplished. A strong beginning � what will GuldGanger do with an entire album?
items.label: Go' Danish Folk Music
items._cn_summary: 这是丹麦三人组合 GuldGanger 的首张数字 EP，共五首曲目，由北欧民谣场景中经验丰富的歌手 Mia Guldhammer 领衔。乐评指出大部分曲目基于传统音乐素材，唯一原创作品来自乐队成员 Morten Musicus。乐评着重描述了乐器的色彩运用：钹琴为传统民谣《Agnete Of Bjergmanden》提供细腻底色，口簧琴与风笛在《Nordgård》中形成驱动力，竖琴与弦乐则在终曲《Orms》中交汇，制造出略带失衡却令人振奋的器乐篇章。整体氛围被形容为古老而带有粗粝质感。乐评认为这支乐队虽为新组合，却已展现出成熟与完整的水准，但对五首曲目之外的方向未作进一步展开。

items.body: Editor's note: When this set of recordings came to me, I was at a loss as to how to share it. It's not music, in any traditional sense (although there is some freestyle rapping), and a 'review' of such an artifact of reality seems superfluous to the content. Instead, I asked sound recordist Ian Brennan if I could simply use his own brief commentary and the recordings he made on the street in Chicago. Twenty-five people afflicted by gun violence participated, many from the very block we�d setup on. Many neighbors were pulled-in spontaneously. Almost every one in the community had been impacted by violence somehow� both on the receiving and the inflicting end, and many both. One woman had just come from a memorial service, another was on her way. That�s how far-reaching the violence. Almost no one went untouched. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors By chance, we convened on the day that Trump ordered the deployment of the National Guard to the city. The recording took place on the front porch of the leader's ninety-four-year-old grandmother's house�right in the heart of the ��hood,� beneath the Midway Airport�s landing path. A pair of stray pitfalls stalked the block. But the grandmother warned not of gunshots, but the mosquitoes in her yard. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors We were in a section of town that one man defined as �the forgotten parts.� Just a short jaunt from the designer clothes shops and posh hotels of the city�s Magnificent Mile, the Southside spawned such legendary Blues artists as Muddy Waters, Willie Dixon, and Howlin� Wolf. Jazz musicians like Lionel Hampton and even Benny Goodman, hailed from nearby. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors The participants ranged in age from seventeen to sixty-seven, but the pattern held true. The person who�d asserted �you�ll really want to hear my story,� was the least compelling. The reluctant, the most moving. One elder�s tough facade broke down as she shared how she�d lost both her sons. She tearfully apologized, �I�m sorry. I�m sorry. I�m sorry.� But she had nothing to be sorry for. Society is the one that owes the apology� for the staggering statistical inequities of which no reasonable defense can be made. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors Editor's note: The full set of recordings are available on Bandcamp. Any profits from this project will be donated to Cure Violence Global , who states that their mission is "advancing an evidence-based health approach to end violence globally." When I asked him about the background sounds, producer Ian Brennan added, "No music is added. It�s all sounds from the source environment. I also ran loops/drones on a different track in the background as they spoke, and when they ended up being incidentally/somewhat magically/eerily synchronous, that is what was used for a few pieces with 'accompaniment' like some of the rap freestyles."
items._genre: field recording / spoken word / sound documentary
items._cn_summary: 这是一张采集自芝加哥南区的实地录音作品，由录音师Ian Brennan在街头录制，25名枪支暴力幸存者参与，涵盖17至67岁各年龄段。部分参与者进行即兴说唱，但整体上更接近声音纪实而非传统音乐创作。录制地点位于一位94岁祖母家的前廊，处于犯罪高发社区，正值特朗普派遣国民警卫队进驻芝加哥当日。作品聚焦被遗忘社区中暴力影响的真实声音，祖母关心蚊子更甚于枪声这一细节刻画了社区的生存状态。一名失去两个儿子的老年女性反复说「对不起」，编辑认为社会才是应当道歉的一方。录音未添加任何配乐，所有声音均来自现场。项目收益将捐给Cure Violence Global。这不是传统意义上的音乐专辑，而是关于暴力、贫困和社会不平等的声音档案。

items.body: After nine previous albums and a 25-year career at the forefront of world music, Lucas Santtana is fluent in the many genres of Brazilian music. His new project, Brasiliano , is a musical exploration of the languages of Brazil. With songs sung in Portuguese, French, English, Spanish, Occitan, Cape Verde Creole, and Tupy-Guarani, a Brazilian native language, Santtana has assembled guest lyricists and vocalists representing a range of musical and linguistic influences. The result is a warm and compelling musical treatise on the diverse cultural history of Brazil, expressed through the Brazilian variant of Portuguese, best described as Brasiliano. Returning to his roots, the opening cut and lead single �A hist�ria de nossa l�ngua� features Gilberto Gil, a national treasure with whom Santtana worked early in his career. As the liner notes explain, Brasiliano , the language, is depicted in the song as a feminine character meeting other people (languages) on her travels, tracing the history of the language as an offshoot of Latin, including �Occitan, Celtic, Galician, Portuguese, Mozarabic, and others. The chorus features Indigenous words that are part of everyday Brazilian culture: Itapu�, Ipanema, Maracan�, Capoeira, etc.� This song acts as a sort of abstract for the dissertation to follow. Santtana and Gil call and respond over what has become the composer�s trademark mixture of detailed, layered, human-played instruments, including on this track violins and violas, piano, guitars, mellotron, and synths. Throughout the record, Santtana creates an inviting effect with a contemporary gloss, combined with the warm resonance of wood, drum skins, wire strings, sticks, bows, and voices. The album features a range of styles, from the lively party track �Ver meu povo se abra�ar� to the convincing reggae of the second single, �Que seja um reggae�. With sophisticated songcraft and inspired arrangements, the songs remain inviting and accessible. Brasiliano by Lucas Santtana Fitting with the theme of the interrelationships among languages, Brasiliano is a celebration of international collaboration. For example, �Independ�ncia� features Karyna Gomes, a singer from Guinea-Bissau; Anglo-French performer Piers Faccini sings �Battre des ailes� accompanied by an appropriately French-sounding accordion; and popular Brazilian singer Flavia Coelho is featured on �Dans le sud feat�. The gentle �Strati di tempo� is the closest to Santtana�s earliest singer/guitarist style, with Italian star Dimartino taking the lead vocals. Brasiliano by Lucas Santtana Language is culture; so too are politics. And with the involvement of Gilberto Gill, who served as Minister of Culture in President Luiz In�cio Lula da Silva�s government and was jailed and exiled for his political affiliations in the 1960s, it is no surprise that this album is overtly political.� For example, on �L�nguas Gerais,� French rapper Oxmo Puccino �speaks about colonization.� Continuing to quote from the liner notes, �Indigenous languages and cultures in South America were buried under European colonization.� Tainara Takua and Oxmo Puccino sing �Cocanha� in Occitan. Their music is part of a movement to prevent this endangered romance language from dying out.� � Like his popular previous recording O Para�so (2023), which was concerned with the environment, Brasiliano is a concept album that explores the role of linguistics in culture. And like on O Para�so , Santtana is never preachy. The high-minded intellectual roots of the project are made palatable by the creative and appealing music assembled to tell the story. It is a message of inclusion, collaboration, and the joy of our shared occupancy in this place and at this time. With many languages, many musical styles, and the artistry of many talented and effective musical partners, Brasiliano is a remarkable achievement in curation and musical skill with a compelling contemporary message. items._cn_summary: Lucas Santtana历经九张专辑与二十五年创作生涯后，推出以巴西语言文化为主线的音乐项目。专辑以'Brasiliano'（巴西葡萄牙语变体）为核心概念，歌词涵盖葡萄牙语、法语、英语、西班牙语、奥克语、佛得角克里奥尔语及图皮-瓜拉尼语等七种语言，并邀请来自几内亚比绍、法国、意大利等地的音乐人参唱。开场曲与Gilberto Gil合作，以隐喻手法追溯葡萄牙语从拉丁语演变为巴西地方变体的历史脉络，歌词融入大量原住民日常词汇如伊帕内玛、马拉卡纳等。制作上延续手工乐器质感与当代编曲的结合，涵盖小提琴、钢琴、吉他、键盘及合成器，风格从派对曲目到雷鬼均有涉及。专辑同时带有明确的政治表达，与Gil的文化部任职背景及流放经历相呼应，展现语言作为文化与政治载体的多重意涵。

opened a window on something so many didn�t even know existed to show that country music had never been a white preserve. That album was a few years before the Carolina Chocolate Drops burst on the scene, reclaiming the Black heritage in country and string band music, plus a great deal more.

items._cn_summary: 这张专辑聚焦于黑人在乡村音乐和弦乐队传统中的历史遗产，追溯了一段被主流叙事长期遮蔽的音乐脉络。乐评将其置于更早期的合辑《From Where I Stand》之后，视为该传统的延续与深化。乐队签约知名厂牌后依然保持了与主流的明显距离，作品赢得格莱美认可。整张专辑强调对原声乐器和口述传统的复兴，将非洲班卓琴、提琴等带有非裔色彩的乐器重新引入当代听众视野。乐评虽短，但点出了该项目的文化意义：它不仅是一场音乐演出，更是一次对黑人音乐根源的重新认领与正名。
